projection: Galactic CAR; longitude decreases left-to-right, l=0 at u=0.5; b=+90 at v=0
limitations: Photographic multi-epoch composite; local distortions up to about 1 degree reported by HNSKY author. Not used for point positions, current planets, naked-eye visibility or astrometry. Runtime low-pass filtering, projection and brightness scaling; no AI modification. The restricted 800-million-pixel original is not included.
